g.text: These are two different events, two years apart, and should not be

g.text: The policy fence moved twice and the

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #23211c

g.text: two regimes do not line up

g.text: A 34.5 kV behind-the-meter SST is probably outside EO 14421 and

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #6d6758

g.text: inside the FCC list, which has no voltage threshold. A

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #6d6758

g.text: unidirectional rectifier-only architecture may sit outside both. The

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #6d6758

g.text: asymmetry is the finding.
